# Results — Study 814 (Trailing-Sharpe Anomaly)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test —
risk-adjusted momentum (Rachev/Biglova et al): rank the cross-section on each name's
**trailing 12-month Sharpe** (mean/std of daily returns, skipping the most recent month à
la 12-1 momentum) and go long high-Sharpe / short low-Sharpe. The honest question is
whether risk-adjusting **helps**, or is just **plain 12-1 momentum + low-vol repackaged**.
Offline & deterministic once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every
number. As-of **2026-06-30** (the last complete calendar month; the partial current month
is dropped). Fingerprint `357fd262912f` (panel Close). Sample as-of 2026-06-30.*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily OHLC (`auto_adjust=True`, total-return), **50 liquid US large-caps**, 2010-01-04 → 2026-06-30, **4,147** dated rows/name |
| Universe | a fixed `UNIVERSE` of ~50 mega-caps, pulled through the **`quantlab.universe` survivorship guard** (`download_panel(..., allow_survivorship_bias=True)`), cached under this study's own `_cache/` |
| Signal | each name's **trailing 12-1 Sharpe** = 252-day mean ÷ population std (ddof=0) of daily returns, formed on the window that **ends 21 days ago** (skips the most recent month), known at the close of `t−1` (one further `shift`) |
| Sort | each day rank the cross-section by the signal; **long the top 30%** (high Sharpe), **short the bottom 30%** (low Sharpe), equal-weight; measure the day-`t` forward return of each book |
| Comparators | plain **12-1 momentum** (cumulative formation-window return) and a pure **low-vol** sort, identical universe/dates/machinery, plus the average per-day rank correlation of the signals |
| Execution / costs | one documented lag: signal through close `t−1` → hold day `t`. The costed timer charges 2 sides × one-way cost × NAV per day on the long-short book; the short book pays 50 bps/yr borrow |
| Statistics | Newey-West (HAC, 10-lag) *t* on the daily spread; one-sample *t*; Welch *t* on the pooled high-vs-low books; a 1,000-permutation placebo; a 20-seed synthetic positive control |

**Survivorship — named on the Signal axis.** `UNIVERSE` is a **current-membership** list
of names that are liquid mega-caps *today*, so the magnitudes are an **upper bound**.

## The headline — long-high-Sharpe / short-low-Sharpe spread

Daily equal-weight top-30% minus bottom-30% trailing-Sharpe spread (n = **3,873** days,
median 50 names/day):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| **spread (long high-Sharpe − short low-Sharpe)** | **+1.29 bps/day** |
| Newey-West(10) *t* | **+0.83** |
| one-sample *t* | +0.79 |
| high-Sharpe book / low-Sharpe book | +8.05 bps / +6.75 bps (Welch *t* = +0.46) |
| gross spread Sharpe (no cost) | 0.20 |

The claimed edge has the **right sign but is not significant** (NW *t* = +0.83, well below
the |t| ≥ 2 bar): on 50 liquid US mega-caps a long-high-Sharpe / short-low-Sharpe book
earns a statistically indistinguishable-from-zero +1.29 bps/day.

## Does risk-adjusting help? — the head-to-head (the whole point)

Same universe, same dates, same sort machinery:

| sort | spread | NW *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| trailing **Sharpe** (long high / short low) | +1.29 bps | +0.83 |
| plain **12-1 momentum** (long winners / short losers) | **+1.59 bps** | +0.99 |
| pure **low-vol** (long low-vol / short high-vol) | −5.65 bps | −2.92 |

| overlap | value |
|---|--:|
| avg per-day rank corr **Sharpe ~ momentum** | **+0.953** |
| avg per-day rank corr **Sharpe ~ (−vol)** | +0.088 |

The verdict on the honesty question is unambiguous: the Sharpe sort is **95% rank-correlated
with plain momentum** — it re-picks almost exactly the names momentum already picks — and
carries **essentially none** of the low-vol tilt (+0.09). Risk-adjusting does **not help**:
the Sharpe book (+1.29 bps, *t* +0.83) is a hair *weaker* than the plain-momentum book it is
built from (+1.59 bps, *t* +0.99), and **neither clears the significance bar** on this
mega-cap universe. The trailing-Sharpe anomaly here is **momentum wearing a risk-adjusted
hat** — same signal, no free lunch from the division. (For the record the *pure* low-vol
sort is significantly *negative* — high-vol mega-caps out-earned — so the low-vol leg, had
it dominated, would have *hurt* the Sharpe book, not helped it.)

## Placebo — is the (weak) relation even a lucky alignment of the sort?

Keep the trailing-Sharpe sort but read each day's forward returns from a **column-permuted**
panel (signal → outcome link broken), 1,000 permutations (20 seeds × 50):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| observed spread | **+1.29 bps** |
| placebo mean (sd) | +0.057 bps (0.986) |
| position of observed | ≈ **+1.25σ** from the null mean (right-tail p = **0.096**) |

The observed spread sits barely above one sigma into the permutation null — consistent with
noise, not a real cross-sectional edge.

## Robustness — two eras (split 2018-01-01)

| era | spread | NW *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| 2010-01 → 2018-01 (n=1,739) | +0.28 bps | **+0.15** |
| 2018-01 → 2026-06 (n=2,134) | +2.12 bps | **+0.89** |

Insignificant in both halves; the (small) positive tilt is entirely a recent-era, still
sub-threshold wobble.

## The timer — can you get paid for it?

Charge 2 sides × one-way × NAV per day on the long-short book; short pays 50 bps/yr borrow.

| one-way cost | gross/day | cost/day | net/day | *t* (net) | Sharpe (net) | ~ann. |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **1 bp** | +1.29 bps | 2.14 bps | **−0.84 bps** | −0.51 | −0.13 | −2.1%/yr |
| **5 bps** | +1.29 bps | 10.14 bps | **−8.84 bps** | −5.40 | −1.38 | −22.3%/yr |

The +1.29 bps/day gross edge is not even significant, and the 2.14 bps/day round-trip
friction at a mere 1 bp one-way already flips it **net-negative**. **Mirage.**

## Synthetic positive control — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic seeded panel with a persistent latent "quality tilt" that sets each name's
volatility (so trailing Sharpe proxies it) and — with `edge>0` — lifts its forward mean. No
network.

| world | spread NW *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (`edge = 0`), **20 seeds** | mean **−0.03** (sd 0.93), **\|t\| ≥ 2 in 1/20 seeds** (≈ the nominal 5% type-I rate) |
| planted (`edge = 0.0016`, seed 814) | **+6.64** (Welch *t* = +6.62) |

The detector recovers a *planted* high-Sharpe → high-return relation cleanly and stays quiet
on the null — so the flat real-tape result is a genuine "nothing here", not a broken sort.
*(A faithful-engine / power check only — never cited in support of the real-tape stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** The trailing-Sharpe (risk-adjusted momentum) sort earns **+1.29
  bps/day** with NW *t* = **+0.83** — right sign, not significant — on 50 liquid US
  mega-caps. It is **95% rank-correlated with plain 12-1 momentum** and carries no low-vol
  tilt (+0.09), so risk-adjusting **adds nothing**: it is a hair *weaker* than the momentum
  book it is built from (+1.59 bps, *t* +0.99), and neither clears |t| ≥ 2. It sits only
  +1.25σ into a 1,000-permutation placebo and is insignificant in both eras. *Survivorship:
  current-membership mega-caps — magnitudes are an upper bound.*
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The gross edge is insignificant and already goes **net-negative
  at 1 bp** one-way (−0.84 bps/day), collapsing to −8.84 bps/day at 5 bps.
